Self-Assessment

A VERY SERIOUS SWOT ANALYSIS

confidential-ish · last updated 2026

+ STRENGTH “Okay, I’ll do it.” I tend to say yes first and figure out the how immediately after.
+ WEAKNESS “CHEESECAKE.” Critical weakness detected.
+ OPPORTUNITY “A problem with no obvious answer.” That’s usually where I get interested.
+ THREAT “One more idea.” Because apparently one solution is never enough.

01field notes
2:00 PMNearby fest ends
~Stall owners pitched
3:00 PMMithiwood begins

Worked directly with the HOD of Marketing on sponsor outreach — one of the biggest sponsors came through this outreach. Another college fest nearby ended around 2 PM; Mithiwood started at 3 PM. I pitched existing stall owners to shift to Mithiwood in that window, and some did.

Sometimes the idea is simply noticing the 1-hour gap.
